mood: Futuristic, high-precision, cinematic, immersive, Apple/Tesla-like engineering showcase

guidelines: No generic fonts for headings (Inter, Roboto, Space Grotesk are banned).
Headings should have tight letter spacing.
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase, tiny, wide-spaced mono font.
Never center-align body text; stick to left-alignment for dense engineering data.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing (Tailwind Scale p-8 to p-32). Cinematic paddings. The bento grid mode B for dashboards, mode A for marketing features.
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 with gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetrical spans (col-span-8 row-span-2 for hero tiles).
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Dense layout for the simulator view.
spacing_and_layout.mobile_first: Ensure all 3D interactives and scroll animations degrade gracefully or use swipe-based gestures on mobile.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for major cards, rounded-lg for inner elements. Subdued curves to maintain technical edge.

cards.hover: Hover lifts slightly (-translate-y-1) and brightens border to border-[#00F0FF]/50 with a subtle drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.1)].

buttons.primary: Solid #00F0FF background, text #030A14 font-semibold, hover:bg-white hover:text-[#030A14] transition-all. Minimalist rectangular with slight rounded corners.
buttons.simulation_cta: Large, glowing button. bg-gradient-to-r from-[#002C4D] to-[#0A1425] border border-[#00F0FF] shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(0,240,255,0.3)].

navigation.header: Sticky with crystal glass (backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#030A14]/70 border-b border-white/10). Hidden on scroll down, revealed on scroll up.

dashboard_elements.panels: Dark #002C4D background or deeply tinted gray-blue. Use 1px #00F0FF borders for active metrics.
dashboard_elements.data_viz: Use Recharts or visx for heatmaps and standard plots, but custom glowing SVGs/Canvas for the turbine telemetry.

motion_and_interactions.scroll_storytelling: MUST USE Framer Motion useScroll hook or CSS view-timeline. Tie text reveals, 3D rotations, and opacity to scroll progress (clamp between 0 and 1).
motion_and_interactions.parallax: Heavy use of parallax for background grids vs foreground text.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Glowing nodes on hover. Lines tracing svg paths (tracing beam effect) around architecture diagrams.
motion_and_interactions.loading_state: Monospace retro-terminal counting up or an ASCII turbine spinning.
motion_and_interactions.3d_elements: React Three Fiber (R3F) + Drei. Use <Environment preset='night'> and floating animations. Custom glowing materials for the turbine blade.

media_urls.description: Close up of a wind turbine blade, great for texturing or backdrop.
Abstract grid pattern with glowing accents. Perfect for section backgrounds behind the dashboard.
Close up of shiny metal object representing the ESP32 / load cells.
Close up view of a jet engine, conveys precision engineering and balancing.

sections_and_content.name: Hero Section
sections_and_content.content: Tagline: 'PRECISION BALANCE MADE SIMPLE' and 'AI-Powered Wind Turbine Blade Balancing'. CTA: 'Explore How It Works'.
sections_and_content.visuals: Animated 3D rotating wind turbine blade (R3F) with a dynamic CG point highlight (glowing neon orange/gold). Deep navy background with cyan rim lighting.

sections_and_content.name: Interactive How It Works (Scroll Story)
sections_and_content.content: Steps: Measure -> Acquire -> Process -> Analyze -> Report.
sections_and_content.visuals: Scroll-linked animation. As user scrolls, view zooms through 1. Blade on 3 load cells (5cm, 22.5cm, 40cm), 2. ESP32 board lighting up, 3. Wireless waves to Raspberry Pi, 4. AI Dashboard appearing, 5. Counterweight suggestion showing. Use framer-motion scroll interpolation.

sections_and_content.name: 3D Interactive Visualization
sections_and_content.content: Legend: Red = High Deviation, Green = Low Deviation.
sections_and_content.visuals: Interactive 3D blade. User can drag to rotate/zoom. Heatmap texture on the blade that shifts from Red (incorrect CG) to Green (corrected CG).

sections_and_content.name: System Architecture Diagram
sections_and_content.content: Data flow: Load Cells -> ESP32 -> Raspberry Pi -> Dashboard -> Report
sections_and_content.visuals: Animated tracing beam (Aceternity style) connecting glowing nodes. Use neon cyan lines on dark background.

sections_and_content.name: Features & Benefits Grid
sections_and_content.content: Features: High Precision, AI Powered, 3D Visualization, Portable, PDF Report, Tare & Calibration. Benefits: Reduces CG Imbalance, Lower Structural Stress.
sections_and_content.visuals: Asymmetrical Bento Grid (Mode A). Use glassmorphic cards with subtle cyan hover glows. Incorporate macro sensor images.

sections_and_content.name: Final CTA / Simulator Launch
sections_and_content.visuals: Full screen cinematic dark section with central glowing CTA button that links to a dedicated /simulator route.

sections_and_content.name: Simulator Route (Dedicated Page)
sections_and_content.content: Live Simulation Tool: Move CG manually, add virtual imbalance weight.
sections_and_content.visuals: Dense Control Room Grid (Mode B). Real-time charts, 3D viewer panel, numeric readouts with JetBrains Mono, sliders for weight input.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme #030A14 background with #00F0FF (cyan) and #FFB600 (gold) glowing accents.
Use framer-motion heavily for scroll-based storytelling (useScroll hook mapping scroll progress to opacity, scale, and y-transform).
Implement the hero wind turbine and interactive visualization using @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei.
Do NOT use 'Inter', 'Roboto', or 'Space Grotesk' fonts. Use 'Outfit' for headings, 'Manrope' for body, and 'JetBrains Mono' for data.
Build a separate fullscreen route for the Live Simulation Tool, adopting a dense, dashboard 'Control Room' bento grid.
Ensure all marketing sections use generous padding (py-24 or py-32) and optical alignment. The brand must feel like an Apple or SpaceX engineering page.
Apply 'glassmorphism' correctly (backdrop-blur-xl with a 1px solid, semi-transparent border, NOT just a muddy transparent background).
